statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41256 (GHSA-vf2h-chrj-q3fg, https://github.com/jqlang/jq/security/advisories/GHSA-vf2h-chrj-q3fg): in jq 1.8.1 and earlier a top-level program loaded with -f is compiled only up to its first embedded NUL byte, so jq silently runs a different program from the bytes in the file. It is fixed by https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/5a015deae35d19e3ebbc65db6c157a80e76df738, which makes jq reject a program file that contains NUL bytes, first released in jq 1.8.2 (https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/tag/jq-1.8.2). Checked /usr/bin/jq in every jq package in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository for x86_64 and aarch64 for the 'program file contains NUL bytes' error that the fix adds: 1.8.1-r0 and 1.8.1_git20260429-r1 are jq 1.8.1 (the version string in /usr/bin/jq) and lack it; 1.8.2_git20260622-r1 and 1.8.2_git20261021-r2 are jq 1.8.2 and have it. The range ends at 1.8.2_git20260622-r1.

CVE-2026-41256 (GHSA-vf2h-chrj-q3fg, https://github.com/jqlang/jq/security/advisories/GHSA-vf2h-chrj-q3fg): in jq 1.8.1 and earlier a top-level program loaded with -f is compiled only up to its first embedded NUL byte, so jq silently runs a different program from the bytes in the file. It is fixed by https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/5a015deae35d19e3ebbc65db6c157a80e76df738, which makes jq reject a program file that contains NUL bytes, first released in jq 1.8.2 (https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/tag/jq-1.8.2). Checked every jq build in the DHI Debian 13 repository for amd64 and arm64, using the changelog each package ships and /usr/bin/jq: rebuilds of Debian 1.7.1-6+deb13u1 and 1.7.1-6+deb13u2, whose changelogs do not list this CVE and whose jq lacks the 'program file contains NUL bytes' error the fix adds; a 1.8.1-5 build (arm64 only) whose changelog is an unreleased Debian 1.8.1-5 snapshot and whose jq also lacks it; and a rebuild of Debian 1.8.2-1, which is upstream jq 1.8.2 and has it. Debian fixed it in trixie in 1.7.1-6+deb13u3 (DSA-6416-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-41256), which has no DHI rebuild, so every build before the rebuild of 1.8.2-1 is affected.
